integrity: Analytic derivation of exact area profile and two-fifths rare-orientation law; a standalone numerical checker is supplementary, not a machine proof or independent certification.
scientific_limitations: Only solid Euclidean three-dimensional ball caps, isotropic orthographic viewing, fixed nonzero clipping height for the five-halves contact expansion; no joint hemispherical transition. Prior projected-cap area formulas are credited. Historical priority is provisional.
title: Sharp five-halves shadow contact and a two-fifths rare-orientation law for spherical caps
